title: Evaluation judgment
description: One graded judgment for one case. A judgment targets an evidence lineage, not rendered text, and keys on source_uid so renaming a source does not invalidate a pack.

case_id.description: Must name a case in this pack's case file.

relevance.description: 0 irrelevant | 1 related context | 2 useful support | 3 authoritative

required.description: Evidence the case cannot be answered without. Recall@k is measured over these.

forbidden.description: Evidence that must not appear near the top: superseded, out of scope, or over the sensitivity ceiling.

supports.description: Which parts of the answer this evidence supports.
